name: Reverberation-mapped quasar 246 (Hubble)
blurb: Quasar 246, a distant quasar and its host galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: 246-hubble
story: At the center of this field shines a quasar whose black hole was weighed by reverberation mapping. Hubble imaged it to separate the quasar's light from its host galaxy's starlight, testing whether black holes and their galaxies grew in step at earlier cosmic times.

claims.text: 246 is a quasar target of Hubble program 17708
The program's targets are broad-line AGNs with reverberation-mapping black hole masses
Hubble imaging separates the quasar light from the host starlight
The aim is to test black hole-galaxy co-evolution at earlier cosmic times
